entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed. It's not working at all.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with how it functions?

It's definitely a technical fault. It just won't sync with my app, no matter what I do. I've spent hours trying. I honestly think the one I got is just broken. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I'm so sad about this. I really needed this money if it was going to be defective.

I completely understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize that the device isn't performing as it should. It sounds like you've done all the right troubleshooting steps. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 18 days ago. Let me just review our return policy for you.

Alright, I've confirmed it here. Our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can absolutely process a return and a full refund for you. I'll email a pre-paid shipping label to you right now.
Oh! Wow, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. You've been a huge help.
You are very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. The email with the label should be in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
